class.name: JRPGEventPage
class.brief_description: One page of a map event: its conditions, graphic, movement, priority and trigger.
class.description: One page of a [JRPGEventData]. The page is the event's active page when all of its enabled conditions hold (two switches on, a variable at or above a number, one of the event's self switches on, an item held, an actor in the party) and no higher page qualifies; a page without conditions always qualifies. While it is active, it sets how the event looks (a character image with a facing and a frame, or a tile of the map's tileset), how it moves on its own, how it meets characters ([member priority]) and what starts it ([member trigger]). Authority: server. Online, the zone decides which page is active.

method.name: are_conditions_met
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every enabled condition holds in [param state] for event [param event_id] of map [param map_id] (whose self switches it reads). A page without conditions always qualifies. The variable condition needs a number at or above [member variable_value]: a variable holding text never meets it.

method.name: get_self_switch_letter
method.description: Returns the letter, [code]"A"[/code] to [code]"D"[/code], of [param self_switch].

method.name: has_any_condition
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when at least one condition is enabled.
